subject: Renewal + Capacity Add-on — billing payor and PO routing
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@nebuladata.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Mehra <sanjay.mehra@nebuladata.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + capacity add-on — PO attached

Connor —

Thanks for the QBR today. We want to move forward with the 12-month renewal at the current commit level, plus a 30% capacity top-up starting Jan 1. Finance asked me to send a PO so we can lock pricing and ensure the dedicated capacity is provisioned before the new term. Attached is PO #1174.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can Redwood route invoices to our procurement team (payor: Nebula Dataworks, Inc, EIN 12-3456789) rather than to our project org?
- Nebula finance prefers Net60; are you able to support Net60 for this renewal? If not, please advise next steps.
- I can attach our W-9 if needed (will send once you confirm recipient).

Thanks — looping Sanjay (finance) to confirm the billing endpoint.

— Liam
Procurement Lead
Nebula Dataworks

Attachment: Nebula_PO_1174.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@nebuladata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add-on — PO attached

Liam —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the PO. We'll start the provisioning queue once billing details are confirmed. A few clarifications so we hand this to billing cleanly:
1) Confirmed payor entity: you wrote "Nebula Dataworks, Inc" (EIN 12-3456789). Is that the legal entity that will sign the DocuSign amendment and receive invoices?
2) Net terms: Redwood's standard is Net30 for renewals with capacity increases. Net60 is possible but requires approval from RevOps for longer terms and may impact when we trigger provisioning. I'll loop in Marissa and Ben to evaluate.
3) Billing contact: please provide the email and phone for whoever should be copied on invoices and billing escalations.

If you can attach the W-9 and confirm payor and billing contact in the reply, we'll open the internal change request and kick off DocuSign.

I'll follow up with a short checklist for finance to make approvals traceable.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@nebuladata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add-on — PO attached

Hi Liam / Connor —

Thanks for the PO. A couple internal notes and a request for Nebula so we can process the order without delays:
- Please confirm the legal payor exactly as it should appear on invoices (company name + billing address). Mismatches between PO and W-9 slow down AR.
- Our billing policy: Net30 is standard. Net60 requests go to Finance and can add ~5 business days to approval; it doesn't block DocuSign but we will hold provisioning until the credit terms are finalized.
- We need an executed W-9 (PDF) from Nebula Dataworks, Inc. Please attach to your reply.
- If the PO covers multiple legal entities or cost centers, indicate which line items map to each entity (otherwise we'll bill against the single entity listed).

Proposed next steps:
1) Nebula confirms legal payor and attaches W-9 (Liam).
2) Redwood generates DocuSign amendment (Connor) and routes to authorized signer.
3) Once DocuSign signed and PO accepted, AR creates invoice and provisioning queue executes.

If Net60 is required, Ben — please advise whether we can approve for NW-1174 under the current risk profile.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Mehra <sanjay.mehra@nebuladata.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@nebuladata.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 11:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add-on — PO attached

Marissa / Connor —

Thanks for the clarity. Confirming:
- Legal payor: "Nebula Dataworks, Inc." (no DBA)
- Billing address: 400 Meridian Ave, Suite 200, San Mateo, CA 94401
- Billing contact: Priya Kaur, priya.kaur@nebuladata.com, +1 (415) 555-0123
- Net terms: Nebula strongly prefers Net60 for this contract. If you can start provisioning earlier with an interim invoice and our PO in place while Finance approves the Net60 term, that would help operations.

Attached is the W-9. We also included a brief corporate resolution PDF in case you need additional payer authority.

— Sanjay
Director of Finance
Nebula Dataworks

Attachments: Nebula_W9_2026.pdf, Nebula_Resolution.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Mehra <sanjay.mehra@nebuladata.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add-on — PO attached

Sanjay / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the W-9. Internal decision: we can provision the 30% capacity top-up into a staging pool and issue an interim invoice using the PO while Finance reviews the Net60 request. A few operational notes:
- I'll file the Net60 exception request today (deal id NW-2026-1174) — approval expected by 2027-01-04 given holidays.
- Connor, I'll need the signed DocuSign amendment before final commit; I can pre-seed the provisioning once DocuSign is sent and the PO is accepted.
- Marissa: charge code will be "NW-1174-ADD" to keep the top-up separate on the invoice.

Liam / Sanjay: I'll send the DocuSign link to the Nebula authorized signer by EOD tomorrow. For tracking, here's the hubspot record and the DocuSign draft: https://app.hubspot.com/companies/0000000/companies/nebula-dataworks and https://www.docusign.net/transaction/ABC123456789

If you confirm Priya as the billing contact, we'll route invoices there and include Liam and Sanjay in copy.

Thanks — happy holidays.
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
